summary: Irish-born coal miner of Plymouth, Luzerne County, Pennsylvania, father of a large family including twin sons; John's 3rd-great-grandfather.
bio:
Martin Murphy was born in Ireland about 1835 and had come to Pennsylvania by 1857, when a child of his was born in Schuylkill County. By 1860 he was living at Plymouth in Luzerne County, and he remained in Plymouth Township through 1870 and 1880.

In 1870 he was working as a miner and owned real estate worth $1,100 and personal property worth $200. With him were his wife Alice, aged 35, and seven children: Mary, 13, Patrick, 12, Catherine, 9, James, 7, John, 4, and the one-month-old twins Martin and Thomas. He died at Plymouth on 8 May 1885 and was buried at Larksville. He is probably John's 3rd-great-grandfather.
